Chapter 6669: Loves A Good Beating

Chapter 6669: Loves A Good Beating

Three Immortals reverted to normal after the founder dao’s collapse. Nevertheless, fear remained in everyone.

“What happened?” Regular cultivators had no idea. They initially thought this was a blessing due to the dao resonance improving their cultivation. This state of mind was highly desirable.

Next, they found themselves melting into the dao and lost control of their body. This scared the soul out of them. Somehow, the process stopped and they became free.

“Run!” Eventually, experts woke up from the daze and some shouted.

In reality, there was no place to hide given their power. An immortal could refine Three Immortals, all hidden dimensions, and the surrounding space. The existence of immortals was a nightmare because with a single thought, they could refine everything.

A broken immortal such as Bao Pu could perform this task with ease, let alone an actual immortal.

Meanwhile, spectators floating in space were shocked by Li Qiye’s kick breaking Bao Pu’s bones.

Supreme Black Ancestor and Weizhen would have found it prohibitively difficult to break the founder dao on top of sending Bao Pu flying. The whole thing was absurd.

Godstallion became slack-jawed and broke out in cold sweat everywhere. He thought his master couldn’t have done this with a single kick. Li Qiye clearly took it easy on him during their encounter or he wouldn’t be here right now.

“A true immortal?” Dugu Yuan and the others turned pale, nearly dropping to the ground.

The other immortals, including Desolate Ancestor, couldn’t have done this. This applied to the two ancient ones as well.

It became increasingly harder for cultivators not to prostrate before Li Qiye after his repeated battles.

“Sir, keep going, this bastard loves a good beating!” Supreme Black Ancestor cheered loudly.

His shouting woke everyone up from their stupor.

“Bao Pu is so cruel.” One primal ancestor remarked on the refinement attempt.

They once dreamed about becoming immortals. The existence of immortals meant they could become one as well. However, it seemed immortals simply had too much power at their disposal.

“Immortals are a disaster in waiting.” Emperors and desolate gods kept this thought to themselves.

Overlords such as Weizhen and Primal Yin Immortal Ghost understood that no shackles were left. They could have devoured Three Immortals as well. The process would just have taken longer.

However, they never thought about it before, not even the fallen ghost. After all, this was their world and home. Their marks could be seen everywhere.

“Ugh...” Bao Pu finally got back up and spat another mouthful.

He only survived due to his immortal frame. Otherwise, that kick could have reduced him to blood.

He was the closest cultivator to the three immortals and had fought primordial immortals before, possessing ample knowledge of this realm. His previous calculation of Li Qiye’s power was mistaken.

“Calling you a broken immortal is already a compliment.” Li Qiye said.

Bao Pu turned red but couldn’t do anything after realizing the power gap.
